args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am writing from Blue Sparrow Tech. I would like to request a private dining table for 12 people next Friday (May 17, 2024).

Could you please let me know your availability and any options you have for private dining? I would also appreciate any information about menus, pricing, and any special requirements for a group of our size.

Please feel free to contact me at emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com or 327-420-4923 if you need any additional information.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech

2. **Sent a professional email** requesting a private dining table for 12 people next Friday (May 17, 2024). The email includes:
